disclosure.exposure_history: Full-stream test set of 5,053 windows across 19 HAPT recordings was exposed during Weeks 1-3 baseline establishment. Week 4 operates as an exploratory follow-up study with strict pre-test protocol sealing.
protocol_stages: 1_INITIAL_PROTOCOL (declarative schema, grids, budgets committed before any fitting)
3_SEALED_TEST_CONFIG (committed frozen policy hash before final test stream replay)

metrics_taxonomy.reuse_count: R = total queries answered via reuse mechanism
metrics_taxonomy.reuse_disagreement: D_reuse = queries where reused decision != frozen reference decision
metrics_taxonomy.fallback_disagreement: D_fallback = queries where fallback execution != frozen reference decision
metrics_taxonomy.reused_agreement_rate: A_reuse = 1.0 - (D_reuse / R) if R > 0 else null
reuse_modes: MODE_2_EXACT_INCREMENTAL (stage-wise feature cache + full Flatten-MLP head)
MODE_3_REGIONAL_CERTIFIED (validated interval / CROWN / Lipschitz domain enclosure)
metrics_taxonomy.heuristic_reuse: Reported strictly as separate empirical trade-off curve; never counted toward certified reuse metrics.

domain_families: fixed_overlap_wave (384D free tail box + 384D fixed prefix)
pca_affine_tail (k-rank PCA projection on 384D tail with bounded residual)

budgets_and_stopping_criteria.timeout_handling: TIMEOUT_ABORT with immediate fallback to reference; no partial state mutations permitted.

validation_selection_contract.objective_function: maximize R_val_cert subject to D_val_reuse == 0 and numerical_gate == PASS
tie_breaking_rules: Note: Zero-radius control is strictly ineligible for selection as a certified configuration.

matching_criteria.geometry_control: Pairing must hold same domain family, same anchor center, and identical coordinate system.
matching_criteria.volume_distinction: Ambient 768D box volume and 384D wave tail volume cannot be compared as same-dimensional volume.
matching_criteria.hull_loss_control: Method M08 (affine projected to outer box) paired with M09 (native correlated propagation) to isolate box-wrapping error.

execution_and_hardware_profile.data_residency: In-memory RAM-resident float32 numpy arrays; disk I/O excluded from inference timer.

measured_phases: cold_setup (model instantiation, weights loading, memory allocation)

uncertainty_and_statistics.secondary_sampling_unit: Repeated timing runs across identical test stream (repetitions=3)
statistical_tests: Paired two-sided t-test across 19 recording clusters
Wilcoxon signed-rank test for paired latency differences
Studentized cluster bootstrap for 95% confidence intervals
